purpose: Emphasize that an action is not done adequately.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
I was so busy that I barely managed to eat.
I operated it without properly reading the instructions.
restrictions: Means not properly or barely, rather than complete nonexistence.

segments.role: Emphasize that an action is not done adequately. ろくに + negative predicate
